body.name: Width-two auxiliary transition arcs
body.construction: Let \(H^{\mathrm{det}}\) be the deterministic-arc subgraph of \(H^{\mathrm{aux}}\), and let \(a_e=(q_e^-,q_e^+)\).  The arc set \(A^{\mathrm{proj}}\) contains exactly: \(\sigma\to t\) when \(\sigma_H\) reaches \(t_H\) in \(H^{\mathrm{det}}\); \(\sigma\to u_e\) when \(\sigma_H\) reaches \(q_e^-\) in \(H^{\mathrm{det}}\); \(u_e\to t\) when \(q_e^+\) reaches \(t_H\) in \(H^{\mathrm{det}}\); and \(u_e\to u_f\) when \(q_e^+\) reaches \(q_f^-\) in \(H^{\mathrm{det}}\).  Length-zero deterministic paths are allowed.
